purpose: Minimum native transaction evidence for burst/persistence hypothesis tests, not live trading

scope.provider_filter: transaction account_include Pump program; static and ALT-loaded keys
scope.rationale: Capture the eligible Pump universe including non-signals for same-period controls; prefiltering teacher wallets or eventual burst tokens would bias it. Direct and CPI invocation identity is decoded after capture.

retention: Full SubscribeUpdate protobuf, hash, session/connection/sequence and subscription hash
Static and loaded ALT accounts, lookup references, outer instructions, inner parent index and stack height
Execution error bytes, pre/post SOL and token balances, fees, logs, return data and compute/cost units
TradeEvent raw bytes, decoded known quote layout and actual event amounts; unknown layout/extensions remain explicit

timing.received_at: Application dequeue after gRPC transport decode, not NIC arrival
timing.normalized_at: Completion of deterministic Rust metadata view
timing.monotonic: Relative to this capture process; compare only within session
timing.provider_created_at: Provider envelope timestamp, not chain execution time
timing.chain_time: Block/event timestamps stored separately; no invented precise execution timestamp
timing.historical_recovery: Metadata becomes known at recovery response; never usable at original decision by relabeling
timing.finalized_reference: Later completeness and execution audit only, never a retroactive signal input

coverage.missing_transactions: Expected minus observed signature sets in hash-selected interior finalized blocks
coverage.slot_discontinuities: Reported separately from proven data loss; chain slots may be skipped
coverage.reconnects: Explicit connection intervals; no silent backfill into native receipt history
coverage.decoder: All transaction frames remain denominator; instruction resolution, event/quote decoding and unknown status counted
coverage.joins: Signature + slot + account identity, availability by one-second boundary; not proof of current executable state
coverage.global_completeness: Unknown unless a complete reference interval is reconciled; no extrapolation from sampled slots

operating_mode: Bounded receive-only capture, default 120s, maximum 3600s; unique output path; no existing collector restart

experiment_readiness.data_now_supports: Independent native burst incidence and one-/two-second continuation/persistence diagnostic against same-period non-signal risk-set controls; ledger/control integration is next, not yet implemented
experiment_readiness.not_yet_enabled: Trustworthy net-PnL ranking: current-state continuity at delayed entry/exit, full fee schedule, own-state impact, attempted-trade accounting and controls integration still required
experiment_readiness.historical_receipts: Teacher-conditioned diagnostic material, not independent control population or reconstructed native execution availability
experiment_readiness.prospective_validation: Fresh data after selecting and freezing a policy; this canary is development/engineering evidence
